QF.id: Evaluating Fund Performance and Fund Selection_49

question.text: Under PFRDA regulations, what is the maximum equity allocation permitted in NPS for subscribers who choose active choice?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under NPS Active Choice, the maximum allocation to equity (Scheme E) is capped at 75% of contributions, as set out on page 112 of the workbook. The Trap: 100% equity is not permitted, and 50% / 25% understate the ceiling. Note: The age-based reduction in equity exposure described on pages 113-116 belongs to Auto Choice / lifecycle funds, not to the Active Choice cap.
